seams.name: Viewer (who is asking, in which tenant)
seams.contract: requireViewer(org): Promise<OrgCtx>; requireViewer(org, ws): Promise<WsCtx>; resolveViewer(org, ws?): Promise<ViewerResolution>; requireUser(next?: SafePath): Promise<PretenantCtx>; readInvitation(token): Promise<InvitationRecord | null> (no session, no interrupt; a malformed or unknown token is null; #3049); requireInvitee(token): Promise<{ctx: InviteeCtx; invitation: InvitationRecord}>. OrgRole is the stored set owner|admin|member|billing|compliance|viewer (schema/org.ts:96,170). OrgCtx, WsCtx, PretenantCtx and InviteeCtx are classes with an ES private field `#brand` installed only by the constructor, `declare`d fields, a protected base constructor (so WsCtx can extend OrgCtx) and private leaf constructors, minted only with the MINT token that viewer-mint.ts exports to viewer.ts and viewer.testing.ts; mint() freezes the instance after construction. The compiler refuses an object literal, a spread, PretenantCtx→OrgCtx, OrgCtx→WsCtx, `new` outside the class and a subclass passing a forged token (six @ts-expect-error cases in viewer.type-test.ts, verified under typescript 6.0.3 and @typescript/native-preview 7.0.0-dev); it cannot refuse Object.assign({}, ctx, {orgId}) (T & U & V is assignable), so `static is(x): x is OrgCtx { return #brand in x }` is checked by the kernel core at runtime and refuses that copy, structuredClone, Object.create(OrgCtx.prototype) and any plain object. Object.assign(ctx, …) throws on the frozen instance. InviteeCtx carries userId, orgId, invitationId and no orgRole, and is accepted by no read path.

seams.name: Kernel read
seams.contract: kernelRead<I,O>(ctx: OrgCtx|WsCtx, {contract: ReadContract<I,O>; input: NoInfer<I>; page: PageKey}): Promise<Read<O>>; overload kernelRead(ctx: PretenantCtx, {contract: UnscopedReadContract, …}) for scoped:false contracts only, whose one caller is src/data/live/pretenant.ts. ReadContract = ToolContract & { mutates: false } (registerCapability<C>(cap: C): C preserves the literal, packages/oxagen/src/registry.ts:48), so a mutating or undeclared contract is a compile error first and a runtime refusal second. ContractOutput<C> is read from the contract's `_output` (zod 3.25 in packages/oxagen vs zod 4 in the app). The shared core first checks the ctx was minted (OrgCtx.is / PretenantCtx.is / InviteeCtx.is → error('invalid_ctx', 500) otherwise), loads @oxagen/handlers/register and @oxagen/agent/register once, builds the CapabilityContext with ctx.surface 'app' and never passes opts.surface (kernel.ts:993 enforces surfaces only when it is passed), lets the kernel enter the tenant scope itself (kernel.ts:1064-1081; the app never calls runInTenantScope), parses output with the contract's own schema, and classifies failures by `code` (never instanceof or message text) into denied | pending_approval{accessRequestId} | error. Read<T> has no exhausted variant: every read the app binds is noBillingGate and the kernel skips both gates on that flag. surface_denied and insufficient_credits have no app producer and are not classified or tested.

seams.name: Kernel write
seams.contract: kernelWrite<I,O>(ctx: OrgCtx|WsCtx, contract: ToolContract, input): Promise<ActionResult<O>>; overload kernelWrite(ctx: PretenantCtx, contract: UnscopedContract, input) for scoped:false contracts (create_org) — the compile-time twin of the runtime re-check; overload kernelWrite(ctx: InviteeCtx, contract: InvitationContract, input) for accept_member_invite and decline_member_invite only. ActionResult<O> = {ok:true; value} | {ok:false; reason:'denied'|'invalid'|'not_found'|'conflict'|'unavailable'; code; field?} | {ok:false; reason:'pending_approval'; accessRequestId} | {ok:false; reason:'exhausted'; code:'gau_exhausted'|'billing_suspended'|'budget_exceeded'}. The core pre-parses input with the contract's own schema and takes `field` from the first zod issue path; a kernel invalid_input after a successful pre-parse is `invalid` with no field. Never throws for a kernel refusal; HandlerError codes forbidden/not_found/conflict map to denied/not_found/conflict. An unminted ctx is refused as {reason:'unavailable', code:'invalid_ctx'}.

seams.name: Data source (what a page may read)
seams.contract: Read<T> = ok | denied{permission} | pending_approval{accessRequestId} | error{code,status} — no exhausted (no app read can produce it) and no not_backed variant from WL-08 on. PageKey = fleet|run|organization|billing|shell and PAGE_FAILURES live in read.ts. DataSource = { pretenant.orgs(PretenantCtx); pretenant.workspaces(PretenantCtx, orgSlug); shell.context(OrgCtx); runs.list(WsCtx,{cursor}); runs.get(WsCtx, runId, {after}); approvals.pending(WsCtx,{runId}); org.members(OrgCtx); org.apiKeys(OrgCtx); billing.plan(OrgCtx); billing.bucket(OrgCtx); billing.contractRate(OrgCtx); billing.invoices(OrgCtx,{cursor}) }. pretenant has exactly two callers (features/shell/landing.ts, features/auth/cli-consent.ts). Every contract behind a port method is noBillingGate (INV-28). dataSource() is the one composition point and returns the live source; components take source as a prop; every method has a production caller (INV-17).

seams.name: Mapper (contract output to view model)
seams.contract: toView(o: ContractOutput<typeof contract>[…]): z.input<typeof View>, a total typed function. View fields are nullable exactly when the contract may not record them, enforced in both directions by mappers.type-test.ts (@ts-expect-error on nullable→required and, via a helper type, on required→nullable). Cost is Cost|null wherever the source may not carry it, and no mapper writes `?? 0`. The adapter parses at the boundary; a parse failure returns error('record_unmappable', 502) reported once. The billing mapper takes Pick<> of the contract outputs that exclude creditBalanceCents and costMicros (get_subscription); get_gau_bucket carries no money at all.

seams.name: Live stream (one SSE transport)
seams.contract: sseResponse<F extends {cursor}>({signal, start, next(after): Promise<Read<{frames: F[]; cursor: string|null}>>, idleMs}): Response — `id:<cursor>` per frame, `event:state` then close on a failed Read. handleRunStream(req, {org, ws}, {resolveViewer, source}): Promise<Response>; route.ts delegates in one line. The cursor is opaque and owned by get_run; every poll is a kernelRead of a noBillingGate contract, so a poll never meters and a revoked membership stops the stream at the next poll. Poll budget: get_run takes waitMs (0…20000; the handler long-polls the ledger every 500 ms inside the tenant scope), handleRunStream passes 20000 and idleMs is 300000, so an idle Run page costs at most three kernel invokes (three audit rows) a minute.

seams.name: Money (one arithmetic and formatting seam)
seams.contract: Money = {micros: string; currency}; Cost = Money & {basis: CostBasis|null}; mulMicros(micros: string, n: number): string is the one BigInt helper (used for the purchase total = rate × quantity); moneyFromMicros converts. <Money value precision='cents'|'exact'> in ui/money.tsx via ui/money-format.ts is the only money formatter, and formatCount in the same module is the only count formatter (GAUs, blocks, tokens). The purchase handler recomputes the amount from resolveContractTerms at submit time, so the client-side total is display only; invoice amounts are read back from Stripe, never computed.

seams.name: Billing terms, provider and webhook (GAU purchase, auto top-up, interim and period-close invoices)
seams.contract: resolveContractTerms(orgId): the effective billing.contract_terms row as {source:'negotiated', …} when one exists, else {source:'published_tier', tier, …} from the billing.plans row of the org's entitled subscription (resolveOrgActionEntitlement's join, plan-allowance.ts:50-99) or the Free plan — organizations.plan_type is not read; every gau_buckets row is one month — periodFor(subscription|null, now): the anniversary-day slice of the current cycle that contains now for a subscriber (a month plan's slice is current_period_start/end; addMonths clamps to the last day of a shorter month), the UTC calendar month for an org with no subscription — and included_gau = included_gau_per_month. Mode: org_billing_settings.approved_for_invoice_billing (default false; invoice_gau_max default 100000 is read only when true; auto_topup_enabled default true, auto_topup_blocks default 1). BillingProvider.createGauCheckout({customerId, orgId, quantityGau, blocks, blockPriceCents, ratePerGauMicros, currency, successUrl, cancelUrl}): mode 'payment', one price_data line (unit_amount blockPriceCents, product metadata oxagen_kind 'gau_block'), quantity = blocks, session metadata {oxagen_kind:'gau_purchase', org_id, gau_quantity, block_size_gau, rate_per_gau_micros, currency}, invoice_creation {enabled: true, invoice_data.metadata: same}, payment_intent_data.setup_future_usage 'off_session'; no {price} branch. BillingProvider.createGauInvoice({customerId, orgId, settlementId, kind, quantityGau, ratePerGauMicros, currency, description, collection}): invoices.create (auto_advance false — Stripe never finalizes or collects a draft Oxagen did not finalize; https://docs.stripe.com/invoicing/integration/automatic-advancement-collection — pending_invoice_items_behavior exclude, metadata {org_id, oxagen_kind gau_auto_topup|gau_interim|gau_period_close, gau_settlement_id, …}, and collection = {collection_method 'charge_automatically', default_payment_method} when the org has a default billing.payment_methods row, else {collection_method 'send_invoice', days_until_due 30}) → invoiceItems.create({invoice, quantity: quantityGau, unit_amount_decimal: rate in cents}), keyed `${settlementId}:invoice` and `:item`; returns {invoiceId}, which the caller persists on the settlement (recordGauInvoice) before the second call. BillingProvider.finalizeAndPayGauInvoice({settlementId, invoiceId}): invoices.retrieve; draft → finalizeInvoice(invoiceId, {auto_advance: true}) (`:finalize`; collection and Stripe's retry schedule start only here); open and charge_automatically → pay({off_session: true}) (`:pay`); returns {status: 'paid'|'open', amountCents, hostedInvoiceUrl}; a card error, SCA, a customer with no payment source and a send_invoice invoice each return 'open'; any other error throws and the row stays pending with its invoice id for the job to resume from Stripe's state. BillingProvider.deleteOrVoidDraftInvoice({settlementId, invoiceId}): invoices.retrieve; draft → invoices.del; open → invoices.voidInvoice (`:void`); void or deleted → nothing; paid → {outcome: 'paid'} with no write; returns {outcome: 'deleted'|'voided'|'paid'|'absent'} and never throws for a state it recognises (a resource_missing on del is 'absent'); called by the close job's superseded branch before settleGauFailed. BillingProvider.getCheckoutPaymentMethod(sessionId) → {id, brand, last4, expMonth, expYear}|null with expand ['payment_intent.payment_method']. BillingCheckoutSession gains invoiceId: string|null; BillingInvoice gains gauSettlementId: string|null from invoice.metadata.gau_settlement_id (read beside resolveInvoiceOrgId). Webhook: checkout.session.completed with oxagen_kind 'gau_purchase' → grantGauPurchaseForCheckout(session): an upsert keyed on stripe_checkout_session_id built from the session metadata, 'paid' only, inserts the gau_settlements 'checkout' row already paid with stripe_invoice_id, adds quantity to the current bucket's purchased_gau through ensureCurrentBucket(tx, …) on a withSystemDb transaction, clears open_topup_settlement_id on the bucket that holds one, and makes the collected card the customer default when none exists (setDefaultPaymentMethod + a billing.payment_methods row with is_default); other sessions keep grantCreditPackForCheckout. invoice.paid with gauSettlementId → settleGauPaid(tx, id) (WHERE status <> 'paid': grants once whether the row was pending, open or failed, to the org's current bucket, and clears the episode; a paid row changes nothing); invoice.payment_failed with gauSettlementId → settleGauOpen(tx, id) (WHERE status = 'pending'; a no-op once the synchronous result recorded open); both on a withSystemDb transaction; onInvoiceRecovered and onInvoicePaymentFailed run only when invoice.subscriptionId !== null (a GAU invoice never resets or starts dunning). syncInvoiceFromStripe (org from invoice.metadata.org_id, stripe-provider.ts:227) and sendPaymentReceipt run for every paid invoice; grantPlanCreditsForInvoicePaid ignores GAU invoices (billing_reason manual, grants.ts:205-217). ensureStripeCustomer(orgId, opts?: {system?: boolean}) reads and writes org_billing_settings.stripe_customer_id through an upsert keyed on org_id, on withSystemDb when opts.system (the close job and set_org_billing_terms); upsertPaymentMethod resolves the org from that column before the subscriptions lookup.

seams.name: Recorder, gate and close job (where the governed action is recorded)
seams.contract: recordGovernedAction({orgId, actions, …}) — the usage recorder bootstrap.ts installs; the kernel calls it once per completed top-level governed invocation inside a re-entered tenant scope, catches anything it throws and never retries it (kernel.ts:1544-1590). Every bucket and settlement writer takes its executor first — ensureCurrentBucket(tx, …), claimAutoTopup(tx, …), claimInterimInvoice(tx, …), recordGauInvoice(tx, …), settleGauPaid(tx, …), settleGauOpen(tx, …), settleGauFailed(tx, …) — the tryInsertGrantLedger(tx, …) shape; the recorder passes a withTenantDb transaction, the webhooks and the job a withSystemDb one. (a) terms = resolveContractTerms(orgId); settings = readOrgBillingSettings(orgId) (a SELECT with column defaults for a missing row; never inserts); mode = approved_for_invoice_billing ? 'invoice' : 'prepaid'; period = periodFor(subscription, now). (b) One statement: ensureCurrentBucket(tx, orgId, {period, terms, usedDelta: n, purchasedDelta: 0}) — INSERT INTO gau_buckets (…) ON CONFLICT (org_id, period_start) DO UPDATE SET used_gau = used_gau + EXCLUDED.used_gau, purchased_gau = purchased_gau + EXCLUDED.purchased_gau RETURNING * — the lazy create (included from the terms, carried from the previous bucket) and the row-locked atomic debit; remaining may go negative; the same function with purchasedDelta is every grant's writer. (c) Prepaid, remaining ≤ 0, auto_topup_enabled and a default billing.payment_methods row: claim one episode with UPDATE gau_buckets SET open_topup_settlement_id = :id, topup_seq = topup_seq + 1 WHERE id = :bucket AND open_topup_settlement_id IS NULL AND included+purchased+carried−used <= 0 RETURNING topup_seq (Postgres re-checks the WHERE after the lock, so one of N concurrent recorders wins), insert the pending 'auto_topup' settlement (quantity = auto_topup_blocks × block_size_gau) in the same transaction, commit, then createGauInvoice (customer = org_billing_settings.stripe_customer_id) → recordGauInvoice → finalizeAndPayGauInvoice; 'paid' → settleGauPaid (WHERE status <> 'paid': status paid, purchased_gau += quantity on the current bucket, episode cleared), 'open' → settleGauOpen (WHERE status = 'pending'; the episode stays set so the month gets no second automatic attempt until that invoice is paid — Stripe's retry or the hosted invoice page — or a paid Checkout clears it). Disabled or no card → no claim; the gate refuses the next action (a Free org has no card until its first Checkout or SetupIntent saves one, the 2026-09-14 rule). (d) Invoice mode: uninvoiced = max(0, used−included−purchased−carried) − overage_invoiced_gau; if ≥ invoice_gau_max, claim with UPDATE … SET overage_invoiced_gau += :max, interim_seq += 1 WHERE … AND used−included−purchased−carried−overage_invoiced_gau >= :max RETURNING interim_seq, insert the 'interim_invoice' settlement (quantity exactly invoice_gau_max), commit, then the same three-step settlement with customer = ensureStripeCustomer(orgId) (tenant scope); accrual restarts at GAU #max+1 by construction; the org never stops; claimInterimInvoice(tx, bucketId, quantity) with quantity = uninvoiced is what set_org_billing_terms calls when it turns invoice billing off. (e) Never throws: a failed provider call leaves the row pending — with no invoice id when create failed, with one otherwise — for the hourly job. assertGauAvailable(orgId) — installed via setBillingAdmissionGate in place of assertCanStartTurn (the credit gate survives only inside the ADR-053 assistant turn): billing_suspended when dunning_state = 'suspended'; ok for invoice billing; ok for prepaid with remaining > 0 (readBucket: a virtual bucket with the previous month's carry when no row exists; the gate never writes, and reads settings through readOrgBillingSettings); otherwise gau_exhausted (402 at the API), with reason 'free_no_payment_method' when the resolved terms are the published Free tier and the org has no default payment_methods row. billing.gau-close (Inngest cron 10 * * * *, hourly; every write on withSystemDb; customers via ensureStripeCustomer(orgId, {system: true})): closeEndedGauPeriods (an ended invoice-mode month with uninvoiced overage → one 'period_close' settlement + closed_at, then the three-step settlement; otherwise closed_at) and resumePendingGauSettlements (pending rows older than an hour: an auto_topup row whose bucket has remaining > 0 → deleteOrVoidDraftInvoice first when stripe_invoice_id is set (a 'paid' outcome settles the row paid instead), then failed 'superseded', no charge; no invoice id and younger than 24 h → createGauInvoice with the same keys; older than 24 h → failed 'idempotency_key_expired' and alerted; an invoice id → finalizeAndPayGauInvoice only). Unique (bucket_id, kind, seq) WHERE seq IS NOT NULL is the database backstop.

worklist.title: ADR-055: subscription GAU buckets, per-month allowances, unit-quantity purchases at a per-customer contracted rate resolved from plan or negotiated terms, two billing modes (prepaid with auto top-up; invoice billing with invoice_gau_max), one settlement ledger with paid as its only terminal state, the rev1 metering surface (refines ADR-052); spec amendment superseding MC spec §12.1, A.8, App. E billing rows and App. A:1947
worklist.acceptance: ADR-055 states: the GAU stays the unit and ADR-052's four exclusions stand; published terms (currency, rate_per_gau_micros, block_size_gau, included_gau_per_month) live on billing.plans and negotiated terms in one billing.contract_terms row per org; the effective terms are resolved at read time by resolveContractTerms, never copied into the org, and organizations.plan_type is not read by the GAU model; every bucket is one month — for a subscriber the anniversary-day slice of the current cycle (periodFor; a month plan's slice is current_period_start/end, schema/billing.ts:77-84; a year plan is sliced by anniversary day with month-end clamping as Stripe's anchor does), for an org with no subscription the UTC calendar month — with included_gau = included_gau_per_month and no multiplier (an annual subscriber gets a monthly allowance and a monthly overage invoice like everyone else), and remaining may be negative; the org's billing mode lives on org_billing_settings (approved_for_invoice_billing default false, invoice_gau_max default 100000 read only when approved, auto_topup_enabled default true, auto_topup_blocks default 1) and is set only by a platform operator through the platformOnly set_org_billing_terms; prepaid: blocks are bought in unit quantities through Checkout or by auto top-up from the recorder path when the bucket reaches remaining ≤ 0, at most one automatic attempt per exhaustion episode — the episode ends when that settlement is paid (synchronously, by Stripe's retry, or through the hosted invoice page), when a paid Checkout clears it, or when the next month opens — and only when that cannot run is the next governed action refused (gau_exhausted); invoice billing: consumption is never capped, overage is invoiced at period end by the daily close job, or as an interim invoice for exactly invoice_gau_max GAUs the day accrued uninvoiced overage reaches it, with a charge on the saved payment method that day when one exists and a send_invoice invoice due in 30 days when none does, accrual restarting at GAU #max+1; an interim invoice does not move the monthly clock; an interim or period-close invoice unpaid on the day leaves the org running, flags it past due and stays collectable by Stripe (retry schedule on a card, hosted invoice page in either case), with no automatic suspension in rev1; a switch from invoice billing to prepaid closes the accrual with an interim invoice for the uninvoiced amount; every block purchase, auto top-up, interim and period-close charge is a Stripe Invoice recorded in billing.gau_settlements (kinds checkout | auto_topup | interim_invoice | period_close; statuses pending | open | paid | failed with paid the only terminal state and the grant conditional on status <> 'paid', so the synchronous result and any later invoice.paid converge on one grant; idempotency by the settlement id and the session id; the claim commits before the first Stripe call); the per-GAU rate printed to the customer comes from the plan or the negotiated row, never from ACTION_RATE_BANDS; tokens are not on the page (get_subscription.periodUsage stays a report the app does not render); retention is off the page and settles later as an invoice line at a contracted per-GB-month rate added to plans and contract_terms by the lane that meters it; create_org grants no credits and the ADR-053 assistant balance of a new org starts at zero; the rev1 metering surface is §1.5 (only resolve_approval is a governed action, and only a decision that matched a row — an unmatched id is a conflict and is never billed; every console read and membership write is noBillingGate); governed_action_counters, plans.included_actions_annual, the credit debit on the action path, OXAGEN_ACTION_METER_MODE and chargeEvidenceRetention are retired; the close job is hourly and per-org; dunning (onInvoiceRecovered / onInvoicePaymentFailed) applies to subscription invoices only. The metering spec §2 (:21-22, :195-198) and §5.6 are amended to the bucket model and the allowance table (:110-115) is restated per month with the maintainer's figures. The MC spec amendment supersedes §12.1's per-run model (:1052-1054), A.8 included_runs (:1865-1881), App. E's billing rows (:2221-2230) — adding purchase_gau_bucket, get_contract_rate, get_gau_bucket, set_auto_topup, set_org_billing_terms, list_invoices and retiring get_action_usage — and App. A:1947 (billing.invoices is retained as the webhook mirror). ADR README index updated.
